data.name: Aiman
data.gender_notes: Aiman is used as a female name in islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Arabic root ي-م-ن (y-m-n), 'to be blessed, right'. Ayman means 'blessed'. Its root is ي-م-ن (y-m-n). A common Muslim given name. Aiman is a Arabic name meaning “Blessed; fortunate; right-handed”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Aiman expresses “Blessed; fortunate; right-handed”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Arabic root ي-م-ن (y-m-n), 'to be blessed, right'. Ayman means 'blessed'.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Aiman total 20, reducing to 2. Number 2 is associated with cooperation, sensitivity and balance.
